class Storage::Entry < ApplicationRecord
  BATCH_SIZE = 500

  belongs_to :account
  belongs_to :board, optional: true
  belongs_to :card, optional: true
  belongs_to :record, polymorphic: true, optional: true

  class << self
    def sync(record)
      return unless record.is_a?(Board) || record.is_a?(Card) || record.is_a?(Comment)

      sync_record(record)
      move_card_comments(record) if record.is_a?(Card)
    end

    def cleanup_board(account:, board_id:)
      loop do
        processed = transaction do
          entries = where(board_id: board_id).order(:id).limit(BATCH_SIZE).lock.to_a
          next 0 if entries.empty?

          card_ids = entries.filter_map(&:card_id).uniq
          surviving_boards_by_card = card_ids.any? ? Card.where(id: card_ids).pluck(:id, :board_id).to_h : {}

          destroyed_entry_ids = []
          deltas_by_board = Hash.new(0)
          account_delta = 0

          entries.each do |entry|
            new_board_id = entry.card_id ? surviving_boards_by_card[entry.card_id] : nil

            if new_board_id && new_board_id != board_id
              entry.update!(board_id: new_board_id)
              deltas_by_board[new_board_id] += entry.bytes_used if entry.bytes_used != 0
            else
              destroyed_entry_ids << entry.id
              account_delta -= entry.bytes_used
            end
          end

          where(id: destroyed_entry_ids).delete_all if destroyed_entry_ids.any?
          apply_deltas(account_id: account.id, deltas_by_board: deltas_by_board, account_delta: account_delta)

          entries.size
        end

        break if processed.zero?
      end
    end

    def cleanup_card(account:, card_id:)
      loop do
        processed = transaction do
          entries = where(card_id: card_id).order(:id).limit(BATCH_SIZE).lock.to_a
          next 0 if entries.empty?

          deltas_by_board = Hash.new(0)
          account_delta = 0

          entries.each do |entry|
            if entry.bytes_used != 0
              deltas_by_board[entry.board_id] -= entry.bytes_used
              account_delta -= entry.bytes_used
            end
          end

          where(id: entries.map(&:id)).delete_all
          apply_deltas(account_id: account.id, deltas_by_board: deltas_by_board, account_delta: account_delta)

          entries.size
        end

        break if processed.zero?
      end
    end

    def cleanup_comment(account:, comment_id:)
      entry = find_by(record_type: "Comment", record_id: comment_id)
      return unless entry

      entry.with_lock do
        removed = entry.bytes_used
        board_id = entry.board_id
        entry.destroy!
        apply_deltas(account_id: account.id, deltas_by_board: { board_id => -removed }, account_delta: -removed) if removed != 0
      end
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
      nil
    end

    def reconcile_account(account)
      where(account_id: account.id).where.not(board_id: account.boards.select(:id)).in_batches(of: BATCH_SIZE).delete_all

      account.boards.find_each do |board|
        reconcile_board(board)
      end

      account.update_column(:bytes_used, account.boards.sum(:bytes_used))
    end

    private
      def sync_record(record)
        attempts = 0

        begin
          board_id = record.current_storage_board_id
          return unless board_id

          entry = find_by(record_type: record.class.name, record_id: record.id) ||
            create_or_find_by!(record_type: record.class.name, record_id: record.id) do |new_entry|
              new_entry.account_id = record.account_id
              new_entry.board_id = board_id
              new_entry.card_id = record.storage_card_id
            end

          entry.with_lock do
            current_board_id = record.current_storage_board_id
            if current_board_id.nil?
              entry.destroy! if entry.bytes_used.zero?
              return
            end

            new_bytes = record.storage_bytes
            old_bytes = entry.bytes_used
            old_board_id = entry.board_id

            deltas_by_board = Hash.new(0)
            account_delta = new_bytes - old_bytes

            if old_board_id != current_board_id
              deltas_by_board[old_board_id] -= old_bytes if old_bytes != 0
              deltas_by_board[current_board_id] += new_bytes if new_bytes != 0
            elsif account_delta != 0
              deltas_by_board[current_board_id] += account_delta
            end

            if new_bytes.zero?
              entry.destroy!
            elsif new_bytes != old_bytes || old_board_id != current_board_id
              entry.update!(bytes_used: new_bytes, board_id: current_board_id)
            end

            apply_deltas(account_id: record.account_id, deltas_by_board: deltas_by_board, account_delta: account_delta)
          end
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
          attempts += 1
          retry if attempts <= 3
          raise
        end
      end

      def move_card_comments(card)
        target_board_id = card.current_storage_board_id
        return unless target_board_id
        return unless where(card_id: card.id, record_type: "Comment").where.not(board_id: target_board_id).exists?

        loop do
          processed = transaction do
            current_board_id = card.current_storage_board_id
            next 0 unless current_board_id

            entries = where(card_id: card.id, record_type: "Comment")
              .where.not(board_id: current_board_id)
              .order(:id)
              .limit(BATCH_SIZE)
              .lock
              .to_a
            next 0 if entries.empty?

            deltas_by_board = Hash.new(0)
            entries.each do |entry|
              if entry.bytes_used != 0
                deltas_by_board[entry.board_id] -= entry.bytes_used
                deltas_by_board[current_board_id] += entry.bytes_used
              end
            end

            where(id: entries.map(&:id)).update_all(board_id: current_board_id)
            apply_deltas(account_id: card.account_id, deltas_by_board: deltas_by_board)

            entries.size
          end

          break if processed.zero?
        end
      end

      def reconcile_board(board)
        purge_orphaned_board_entries(board)

        sync_record(board)

        Card.where(board_id: board.id).joins(:image_attachment).find_each { |card| sync_record(card) }
        Card.where(board_id: board.id).joins(rich_text_description: :embeds_attachments).distinct.find_each { |card| sync_record(card) }
        Comment.joins(:card, rich_text_body: :embeds_attachments).where(cards: { board_id: board.id }).distinct.find_each { |comment| sync_record(comment) }

        board.update_column(:bytes_used, where(board_id: board.id).sum(:bytes_used))
      end

      def purge_orphaned_board_entries(board)
        where(board_id: board.id).find_each do |entry|
          if entry.record
            sync_record(entry.record)
          else
            entry.destroy!
          end
        end
      end

      def apply_deltas(account_id:, deltas_by_board: {}, account_delta: 0)
        deltas_by_board.sort_by(&:first).each do |board_id, delta|
          next if delta.zero?
          Board.where(id: board_id).update_all([ "bytes_used = bytes_used + ?", delta ])
        end

        if account_delta != 0
          Account.where(id: account_id).update_all([ "bytes_used = bytes_used + ?", account_delta ])
        end
      end
  end
end
EOF

  def purge

**The Mystery of the Missing `after_create_commit` Callback**

Okay, hold on a minute! I'm looking at these two outputs, and something doesn't add up. First, after `board1.update!` ran, `att.storage_sync_target` gave me a `#<Board ...>`. But then, during the `after_create_commit` on an `Attachment`, `storage_sync_target` was `nil`! What's going on here?

I need to dig deeper. I'm focusing on how `ActiveSupport.on_load(:active_storage_attachment)` and `after_create_commit` work in relation to each other. Wait, when `board1.update!(public_description: ...)` ran, I noticed something strange in the previous output: the `richtext record: ...` was printed BEFORE the `DEBUG sync_storage_later called!` message. But, the `board1.update!` had already returned. (Wait: why did `puts "richtext record"` print BEFORE `DEBUG sync_storage_later`? NO, `board1.update!` ran `after_create_commit`... wait: NO!! Look closely at the previous output:
`richtext record:` printed FIRST!
`DEBUG sync_storage_later called!` printed SECOND!
WHY DID `after_create_commit` RUN DURING `account.destroy!` INSTEAD OF `board1.update!`?!!

I'm checking the `DEBUG sync_storage_later` output: it says `record_type=ActionText::RichText name=embeds record_id=03ha9vb7d3sknv842j6afdyw1`. Ah, right! During the `account.destroy!`, the `after_destroy_commit` also calls `sync_storage_later`, and the `target=nil` because `RichText` was destroyed! That explains it.

Wait a second, THAT MEANS `after_create_commit` DID NOT FIRE AT ALL DURING `board1.update!`!

Why didn't `after_create_commit` trigger during that update? I need to re-examine `ActiveSupport.on_load(:active_storage_attachment)`. Recall earlier when printing `ActiveStorage::Attachment._commit_callbacks.map(&:filter)`, I see `[:sync_storage_later, :purge_dependent_blob, :run_upload_callbacks]`. I'm starting to suspect there's a problem with when `after_create_commit :sync_storage_later` should have been called, and now I'm thinking back to my understanding of `ActiveRecord::Transactions`.

Aha! In Rails, `after_create_commit :foo` actually registers an `after_commit :foo, on: :create` callback. So, I see now... Look at how `after_create_commit :sync_storage_later` and `after_destroy_commit :sync_storage_later` are defined in `lib/rails_ext/active_storage_storage_tracking.rb`:

Wait a minute, it's overwriting the previous definition! Because in Rails, if you define `after_create_commit :sync_storage_later` and THEN `after_destroy_commit :sync_storage_later` with the **SAME SYMBOL** `:sync_storage_later`, it actually overwrites the first callback! `on: :create` is replaced by `on: :destroy`! The problem is that `ActiveSupport::Callbacks` deduplicates callbacks with the SAME `filter` name (`:sync_storage_later`) on the same class!!

That's it! What a catch! Looking closer at how Rails' `set_callback` method works: if you register `after_create_commit :sync_storage_later` AND THEN `after_destroy_commit :sync_storage_later`, `ActiveSupport` replaces the `:sync_storage_later` callback, leaving ONLY `on: :destroy`!

The solution is clear: instead, use:
`after_commit :sync_storage_later, on: %i[ create destroy ]`!

I should test that right now!

**System User Oversight**

Right, that's it! I just realized a subtle but critical distinction. The standard `Account.create!` method *doesn't* automatically provision that vital `system` user that we often rely on. It seems `Account.create_with_owner` has that built-in behavior, and I hadn't made that connection before.

The implication is clear. Before I proceed, I need to explicitly create this system user myself, mirroring the implicit behavior of `create_with_owner`. That will take care of the omission. arguments.command:
RAILS_ENV=test bin/rails runner '
Account.where(name: "StorageTestAcct").destroy_all
ActiveStorage::Blob.where(filename: %w[a.txt b.txt c.txt d.txt avatar.png]).destroy_all

include ActiveJob::TestHelper
ActiveJob::Base.queue_adapter = :test

account = Account.create!(name: "StorageTestAcct")
account.users.create!(role: :system, name: "System")
user = account.users.create!(name: "Owner", role: :owner)

Current.set(account: account, user: user) do
  board1 = Board.create!(name: "Board 1", creator: user, account: account)
  board2 = Board.create!(name: "Board 2", creator: user, account: account)

  blob_100 = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(io: StringIO.new("a" * 100), filename: "a.txt", content_type: "text/plain")
  blob_250 = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(io: StringIO.new("b" * 250), filename: "b.txt", content_type: "text/plain")
  blob_400 = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(io: StringIO.new("c" * 400), filename: "c.txt", content_type: "text/plain")
  blob_50 = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(io: StringIO.new("d" * 50), filename: "d.txt", content_type: "text/plain")
  avatar_blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(io: File.open("test/fixtures/files/avatar.png"), filename: "avatar.png", content_type: "image/png")

  # 1. Avatar should NOT be counted
  user.avatar.attach(avatar_blob)
  perform_enqueued_jobs
  raise "Avatar counted! acct=#{account.reload.bytes_used}" unless account.reload.bytes_used == 0 && board1.reload.bytes_used == 0

  # 2. Board public_description embed (50)
  board1.update!(public_description: "<action-text-attachment sgid=\"#{blob_50.attachable_sgid}\"></action-text-attachment>")
  perform_enqueued_jobs
  raise "Step 2 failed: board1=#{board1.reload.bytes_used}, acct=#{account.reload.bytes_used}" unless board1.reload.bytes_used == 50 && account.reload.bytes_used == 50

  # 3. Card image (100) + Card description embed (250) + Comment body embed (400)
  card = Card.create!(title: "Card", board: board1, creator: user, status: :published, image: blob_100,
    description: "<action-text-attachment sgid=\"#{blob_250.attachable_sgid}\"></action-text-attachment>")
  comment = card.comments.create!(creator: user, body: "<action-text-attachment sgid=\"#{blob_400.attachable_sgid}\"></action-text-attachment>")
  perform_enqueued_jobs
  expected_b1 = 50 + 100 + 250 + 400
  raise "Step 3 failed: board1=#{board1.reload.bytes_used}, acct=#{account.reload.bytes_used}" unless board1.reload.bytes_used == expected_b1 && account.reload.bytes_used == expected_b1

  # 4. Card move to board2
  card.move_to(board2)
  perform_enqueued_jobs
  raise "Step 4 failed: b1=#{board1.reload.bytes_used}, b2=#{board2.reload.bytes_used}, acct=#{account.reload.bytes_used}" unless board1.reload.bytes_used == 50 && board2.reload.bytes_used == 750 && account.reload.bytes_used == 800

  # 5. purge_later on card image (-100)
  card.image.purge_later
  perform_enqueued_jobs
  raise "Step 5 failed: b2=#{board2.reload.bytes_used}, acct=#{account.reload.bytes_used}" unless board2.reload.bytes_used == 650 && account.reload.bytes_used == 700

  # 6. destroy comment (-400)
  comment.destroy!
  perform_enqueued_jobs
  raise "Step 6 failed: b2=#{board2.reload.bytes_used}, acct=#{account.reload.bytes_used}" unless board2.reload.bytes_used == 250 && account.reload.bytes_used == 300

  # 7. destroy board2 (-250)
  board2.destroy!
  perform_enqueued_jobs
  raise "Step 7 failed: acct=#{account.reload.bytes_used}" unless account.reload.bytes_used == 50

  puts "ALL LIFECYCLE CHECKS PASSED!"
end
account.destroy!
ActiveStorage::Blob.where(filename: %w[a.txt b.txt c.txt d.txt avatar.png]).destroy_all
'

messages.content: `Card#handle_board_change` calls `update! column: nil` in an `after_update` callback, which clears `saved_change_to_board_id?` before `after_update_commit` runs. Let's track the board change in `before_update` (and clear on `after_rollback`) in `Card::Storage` and re-run our verification script!
messages.thinking:
**Debugging a Tricky ActiveRecord Callback Issue**

Okay, here's the deal. I just hit a wall—Step 4 failed, and I see that `sync_storage_later` isn't running when it should. The initial clue is this `card.move_to(board2)` call, which wasn't triggering what it was expected. My first instinct, as always, is to dive into the models. I check `app/models/card.rb` and `app/models/card/storage.rb` straight away.

Boom! I find a critical `after_update :handle_board_change, if: :saved_change_to_board_id?` in `Card`. The logic inside that method is a transaction which calls `update! column: nil`. That’s where it starts to click. It seems that `handle_board_change` is running *after* the initial board update, but then it’s *also* modifying the model within the same transaction. The `update! column: nil` call then clears the `saved_changes` hash, including the critical `board_id` change, before `after_update_commit` runs! Because the update calls `update!` to set `column`, the `saved_change_to_board_id?` ends up being `false` when it’s finally checked, which is why `sync_storage_later` isn't running. It’s like the board change gets overwritten by the column update, causing the callback condition to fail.

The solution is clear. I need to make sure the board change is recorded BEFORE the column update within the transaction. One option is to move the board change tracking to a different callback, like `after_update :track_board_change_for_storage, if: :saved_change_to_board_id?`. Another option is using `before_update` so it executes before `handle_board_change`. An even simpler option: track `@storage_board_changed = true` in `after_update` when the `board_id` is updated, and then check that variable in `after_update_commit`. I could also use a `before_update` callback, like `before_update :mark_storage_board_changed, if: :will_save_change_to_board_id?` and then in `after_commit` I would `sync_storage_later` only if `@storage_board_changed` is true, after it is reset to false. However, what if that rollback? I realize I need to clear that flag in `after_rollback` to prevent potential issues. Even better, combining it into one block will be cleaner. Using `after_update` is safe because `Card::Storage` is included in `Card` BEFORE the `after_update :handle_board_change` (or that `after_update` callback runs *after* it’s included). This guarantees `@storage_board_changed = true` is always set before `handle_board_change`. Or, if `handle_board_change` runs first, the `update!` call *inside* it still updates the `mutations_before_last_save` hash, so `mark_storage_board_changed` still runs correctly.

So, I’m going to go with the `before_update :mark_storage_board_changed, if: :will_save_change_to_board_id?` approach in `app/models/card/storage.rb` and re-run that full lifecycle test. Hopefully, that should solve this issue for good!

arguments.command:
cat <<'EOF' > app/models/card/storage.rb
module Card::Storage
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    include ::Storage::Tracked

    before_update :mark_storage_board_changed, if: :will_save_change_to_board_id?
    after_update_commit :sync_storage_on_board_change
    after_rollback :clear_storage_board_changed
  end

  def storage_bytes
    image_bytes + description_bytes
  end

  def current_storage_board_id
    Card.where(id: id).pick(:board_id)
  end

  def storage_card_id
    id
  end

  private
    def mark_storage_board_changed
      @storage_board_changed = true
    end

    def sync_storage_on_board_change
      if @storage_board_changed
        @storage_board_changed = false
        sync_storage_later
      end
    end

    def clear_storage_board_changed
      @storage_board_changed = false
    end

    def image_bytes
      ActiveStorage::Attachment
        .joins(:blob)
        .where(record_type: "Card", record_id: id, name: "image")
        .sum("active_storage_blobs.byte_size")
    end

    def description_bytes
      ActiveStorage::Attachment
        .joins(:blob)
        .joins("INNER JOIN action_text_rich_texts ON action_text_rich_texts.id = active_storage_attachments.record_id")
        .where(
          active_storage_attachments: { record_type: "ActionText::RichText", name: "embeds" },
          action_text_rich_texts: { record_type: "Card", record_id: id, name: "description" }
        )
        .sum("active_storage_blobs.byte_size")
    end
end
EOF

require "test_helper"

class Storage::EntryTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    @account = accounts("37s")
    @board = boards(:writebook)
    @other_board = boards(:miltons_wish_list)
    @user = users(:david)
  end

  test "bytes_used defaults to 0 on accounts and boards" do
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks card image attachments in the background" do
    card = nil
    blob = create_blob(size: 1_234, filename: "cover.txt")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card = @board.cards.create!(title: "With image", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    end

    assert_equal 1_234, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_234, @account.reload.bytes_used

    replacement_blob = create_blob(size: 2_500, filename: "cover2.txt")
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.update!(image: replacement_blob)
    end

    assert_equal 2_500, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 2_500, @account.reload.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.purge_later
    end

    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(account: @account).count
  end

  test "tracks card image detach and purge" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 800, filename: "photo.txt")
    card = nil

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Detach test", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    end
    assert_equal 800, @board.reload.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.detach
    end
    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used

    blob2 = create_blob(size: 900, filename: "photo2.txt")
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.attach(blob2)
    end
    assert_equal 900, @board.reload.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.purge
    end
    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks drafted cards as well as published cards" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 450, filename: "draft.txt")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.cards.create!(title: "Draft", creator: @user, status: :drafted, image: blob)
    end

    assert_equal 450, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 450, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks embeds in board descriptions, card descriptions, and comments" do
    board_blob = create_blob(size: 100, filename: "board.txt")
    card_blob_1 = create_blob(size: 200, filename: "card1.txt")
    card_blob_2 = create_blob(size: 300, filename: "card2.txt")
    comment_blob = create_blob(size: 400, filename: "comment.txt")

    card = nil
    comment = nil

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
      card = @board.cards.create!(
        title: "Embeds",
        creator: @user,
        status: :published,
        description: embed_html(card_blob_1, card_blob_2)
      )
      comment = card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment_blob))
    end

    assert_equal 1_000, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_000, @account.reload.bytes_used

    # Edit card description to remove one embed and edit comment to remove its embed
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.update!(description: embed_html(card_blob_1))
      comment.update!(body: "No attachments anymore")
    end

    assert_equal 300, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 300, @account.reload.bytes_used

    # Clear board description embed
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.update!(public_description: "Plain description")
    end

    assert_equal 200, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 200, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks embedded images without double-counting generated variants" do
    image_file = file_fixture("moon.jpg")
    image_size = image_file.size
    blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
      io: image_file.open,
      filename: "moon.jpg",
      content_type: "image/jpeg"
    )

    card = nil
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card = @board.cards.create!(
        title: "Image embed",
        creator: @user,
        status: :published,
        description: embed_html(blob)
      )
    end

    assert_operator card.rich_text_description.embeds_attachments.first.blob.variant_records.count, :>, 0
    assert_equal image_size, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal image_size, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "ignores user avatars, identity avatars, exports, and imports" do
    avatar_blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
      io: file_fixture("avatar.png").open,
      filename: "avatar.png",
      content_type: "image/png"
    )
    identity_avatar_blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
      io: file_fixture("avatar.png").open,
      filename: "id_avatar.png",
      content_type: "image/png"
    )
    export_blob = create_blob(size: 5_000, filename: "export.zip")
    import_blob = create_blob(size: 6_000, filename: "import.zip")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @user.avatar.attach(avatar_blob)
      @user.identity.avatar.attach(identity_avatar_blob)
      Account::Export.create!(account: @account, user: @user, file: export_blob)
      Account::Import.create!(account: @account, identity: @user.identity, file: import_blob)
    end

    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "moves storage usage when a card moves to another board" do
    image_blob = create_blob(size: 150, filename: "img.txt")
    desc_blob = create_blob(size: 250, filename: "desc.txt")
    comment_blob = create_blob(size: 350, filename: "comment.txt")
    board_blob = create_blob(size: 100, filename: "board.txt")

    card = nil
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
      card = @board.cards.create!(
        title: "Movable",
        creator: @user,
        status: :published,
        image: image_blob,
        description: embed_html(desc_blob)
      )
      card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment_blob))
    end

    assert_equal 850, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @other_board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 850, @account.reload.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.move_to(@other_board)
    end

    assert_equal 100, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 750, @other_board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 850, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "cleans up storage usage when comment, card, or board is destroyed" do
    board_blob = create_blob(size: 100, filename: "b.txt")
    card_blob = create_blob(size: 200, filename: "c.txt")
    comment1_blob = create_blob(size: 300, filename: "cm1.txt")
    comment2_blob = create_blob(size: 400, filename: "cm2.txt")

    card = nil
    comment1 = nil

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
      card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Destroyable", creator: @user, status: :published, image: card_blob)
      comment1 = card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment1_blob))
      card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment2_blob))
    end

    assert_equal 1_000, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_000, @account.reload.bytes_used

    # Destroying one comment subtracts only that comment
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      comment1.destroy!
    end
    assert_equal 700, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 700, @account.reload.bytes_used

    # Destroying the card cleans up the card and remaining comment in one cleanup job
    assert_enqueued_jobs 1, only: Storage::CleanupJob do
      card.destroy!
    end
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 100, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 100, @account.reload.bytes_used

    # Destroying a board with cards and comments enqueues only one cleanup job
    card2 = nil
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card2 = @board.cards.create!(title: "Another", creator: @user, status: :published, image: create_blob(size: 500, filename: "c2.txt"))
      card2.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(create_blob(size: 600, filename: "cm3.txt")))
    end
    assert_equal 1_200, @account.reload.bytes_used

    assert_enqueued_jobs 1, only: Storage::CleanupJob do
      @board.destroy!
    end
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(board_id: @board.id).count
  end

  test "board destruction preserves storage for cards concurrently moved to another board" do
    card_blob = create_blob(size: 500, filename: "moved.txt")
    staying_blob = create_blob(size: 300, filename: "staying.txt")
    card = nil

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Moved", creator: @user, status: :published, image: card_blob)
      @board.cards.create!(title: "Staying", creator: @user, status: :published, image: staying_blob)
    end

    assert_equal 800, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 800, @account.reload.bytes_used

    # Move card without running its sync job yet, then destroy old board
    card.move_to(@other_board)
    @board.destroy!
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 500, @other_board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 500, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "creating and destroying before jobs run leaves zero usage" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 777, filename: "ephemeral.txt")
    card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Ephemeral", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    card.destroy!

    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "sync is idempotent and isolates accounts" do
    other_account = accounts(:initech)
    other_board = boards(:initech_main)
    blob1 = create_blob(size: 333, filename: "37s.txt")
    blob2 = nil

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card = @board.cards.create!(title: "37s card", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob1)
      card.sync_storage_now
      card.sync_storage_now
    end

    Current.set(account: other_account, user: users(:mike)) do
      blob2 = create_blob(size: 444, filename: "initech.txt")
      perform_enqueued_jobs do
        other_board.cards.create!(title: "Initech card", creator: users(:mike), status: :published, image: blob2)
      end
    end

    assert_equal 333, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 333, @account.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 444, other_board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 444, other_account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "reconcile_storage_now repairs drifted totals and orphaned entries" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 1_000, filename: "reconcile.txt")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.cards.create!(title: "Tracked", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    end

    # Simulate drift and an orphaned entry
    @board.update_column(:bytes_used, 999_999)
    @account.update_column(:bytes_used, 123)
    Storage::Entry.create!(
      account_id: @account.id,
      board_id: @board.id,
      card_id: "nonexistent_card_id",
      record_type: "Card",
      record_id: "nonexistent_card_id",
      bytes_used: 5_000
    )

    @account.reconcile_storage_now

    assert_equal 1_000, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_000, @account.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1, Storage::Entry.where(account: @account).count
  end

  test "account destruction removes storage entries without errors" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 555, filename: "acct_destroy.txt")
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.cards.create!(title: "Card", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    end
    assert_equal 1, Storage::Entry.where(account: @account).count

    assert_no_enqueued_jobs only: Storage::CleanupJob do
      @account.destroy!
    end

    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(account_id: @account.id).count
  end

  private
    def create_blob(size:, filename:)
      ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
        io: StringIO.new("x" * size),
        filename: filename,
        content_type: "text/plain"
      )
    end

    def embed_html(*blobs)
      blobs.map { |blob| %(<action-text-attachment sgid="#{blob.attachable_sgid}"></action-text-attachment>) }.join
    end
end

require "test_helper"

class Storage::EntryTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    Current.session = sessions(:david)
    @account = accounts("37s")
    @board = boards(:writebook)
    @other_board = boards(:private)
    @user = users(:david)
  end

  test "bytes_used defaults to 0 on accounts and boards" do
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks card image attachments in the background" do
    card = nil
    blob = create_blob(size: 1_234, filename: "cover.txt")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card = @board.cards.create!(title: "With image", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    end

    assert_equal 1_234, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_234, @account.reload.bytes_used

    replacement_blob = create_blob(size: 2_500, filename: "cover2.txt")
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.update!(image: replacement_blob)
    end

    assert_equal 2_500, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 2_500, @account.reload.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.purge_later
    end

    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(account: @account).count
  end

  test "tracks card image detach and purge" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 800, filename: "photo.txt")
    card = nil

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Detach test", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    end
    assert_equal 800, @board.reload.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.detach
    end
    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used

    blob2 = create_blob(size: 900, filename: "photo2.txt")
    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.attach(blob2)
    end
    assert_equal 900, @board.reload.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.image.purge
    end
    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks drafted cards as well as published cards" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 450, filename: "draft.txt")

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.cards.create!(title: "Draft", creator: @user, status: :drafted, image: blob)
    end

    assert_equal 450, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 450, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks embeds in board descriptions, card descriptions, and comments" do
    board_blob = create_blob(size: 100, filename: "board.txt")
    card_blob_1 = create_blob(size: 200, filename: "card1.txt")
    card_blob_2 = create_blob(size: 300, filename: "card2.txt")
    comment_blob = create_blob(size: 400, filename: "comment.txt")

    card = nil
    comment = nil

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
      card = @board.cards.create!(
        title: "Embeds",
        creator: @user,
        status: :published,
        description: embed_html(card_blob_1, card_blob_2)
      )
      comment = card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment_blob))
    end

    assert_equal 1_000, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_000, @account.reload.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      card.update!(description: embed_html(card_blob_1))
      comment.update!(body: "No attachments anymore")
    end

    assert_equal 300, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 300, @account.reload.bytes_used

    perform_enqueued_jobs do
      @board.update!(public_description: "Plain description")
    end

    assert_equal 200, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 200, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks embedded images without double-counting generated variants" do
    image_file = file_fixture("moon.jpg")

      )

    assert_operator card.rich_text_description.embeds_attachments.first.blob.variant_records.count, :>, 0
    assert_equal image_size, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal image_size, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "ignores user avatars, exports, and imports" do
    avatar_blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
      io: file_fixture("avatar.png").open,

require "test_helper"

class Storage::EntryTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    Current.session = sessions(:david)
    @account = accounts("37s")
    @board = boards(:writebook)
    @other_board = boards(:private)
    @user = users(:david)
  end

  test "bytes_used defaults to 0 on accounts and boards" do
    assert_equal 0, @account.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @board.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks card image attachments in the background" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 1_234, filename: "cover.txt")
    card = @board.cards.create!(title: "With image", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 1_234, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_234, @account.reload.bytes_used

    replacement_blob = create_blob(size: 2_500, filename: "cover2.txt")
    card.update!(image: replacement_blob)
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 2_500, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 2_500, @account.reload.bytes_used

    card.image.purge_later
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(account: @account).count
  end

  test "tracks card image detach and purge" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 800, filename: "photo.txt")
    card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Detach test", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    assert_equal 800, @board.reload.bytes_used

    card.image.detach
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used

    blob2 = create_blob(size: 900, filename: "photo2.txt")
    card.image.attach(blob2)
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    assert_equal 900, @board.reload.bytes_used

    card.image.purge
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks drafted cards as well as published cards" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 450, filename: "draft.txt")
    @board.cards.create!(title: "Draft", creator: @user, status: :drafted, image: blob)
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 450, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 450, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks embeds in board descriptions, card descriptions, and comments" do
    board_blob = create_blob(size: 100, filename: "board.txt")
    card_blob_1 = create_blob(size: 200, filename: "card1.txt")
    card_blob_2 = create_blob(size: 300, filename: "card2.txt")
    comment_blob = create_blob(size: 400, filename: "comment.txt")

    @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
    card = @board.cards.create!(
      title: "Embeds",
      creator: @user,
      status: :published,
      description: embed_html(card_blob_1, card_blob_2)
    )
    comment = card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment_blob))
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 1_000, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_000, @account.reload.bytes_used

    card.update!(description: embed_html(card_blob_1))
    comment.update!(body: "No attachments anymore")
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 300, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 300, @account.reload.bytes_used

    @board.update!(public_description: "Plain description")
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 200, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 200, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "tracks embedded images without double-counting generated variants" do
    image_file = file_fixture("moon.jpg")
    image_size = image_file.size
    blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
      io: image_file.open,
      filename: "moon.jpg",
      content_type: "image/jpeg"
    )

    card = @board.cards.create!(
      title: "Image embed",
      creator: @user,
      status: :published,
      description: embed_html(blob)
    )
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_operator card.rich_text_description.embeds_attachments.first.blob.variant_records.count, :>, 0
    assert_equal image_size, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal image_size, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "ignores user avatars, exports, and imports" do
    avatar_blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
      io: file_fixture("avatar.png").open,
      filename: "avatar.png",
      content_type: "image/png"
    )
    export_blob = create_blob(size: 5_000, filename: "export.zip")
    import_blob = create_blob(size: 6_000, filename: "import.zip")

    @user.avatar.attach(avatar_blob)
    Account::Export.create!(account: @account, user: @user, file: export_blob)
    Account::Import.create!(account: @account, identity: @user.identity, file: import_blob)
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "moves storage usage when a card moves to another board" do
    image_blob = create_blob(size: 150, filename: "img.txt")
    desc_blob = create_blob(size: 250, filename: "desc.txt")
    comment_blob = create_blob(size: 350, filename: "comment.txt")
    board_blob = create_blob(size: 100, filename: "board.txt")

    @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
    card = @board.cards.create!(
      title: "Movable",
      creator: @user,
      status: :published,
      image: image_blob,
      description: embed_html(desc_blob)
    )
    card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment_blob))
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 850, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @other_board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 850, @account.reload.bytes_used

    card.move_to(@other_board)
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 100, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 750, @other_board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 850, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "cleans up storage usage when comment, card, or board is destroyed" do
    board_blob = create_blob(size: 100, filename: "b.txt")
    card_blob = create_blob(size: 200, filename: "c.txt")
    comment1_blob = create_blob(size: 300, filename: "cm1.txt")
    comment2_blob = create_blob(size: 400, filename: "cm2.txt")

    @board.update!(public_description: embed_html(board_blob))
    card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Destroyable", creator: @user, status: :published, image: card_blob)
    comment1 = card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment1_blob))
    card.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(comment2_blob))
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 1_000, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_000, @account.reload.bytes_used

    comment1.destroy!
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    assert_equal 700, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 700, @account.reload.bytes_used

    assert_enqueued_jobs 1, only: Storage::CleanupJob do
      card.destroy!
    end
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 100, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 100, @account.reload.bytes_used

    card2 = @board.cards.create!(title: "Another", creator: @user, status: :published, image: create_blob(size: 500, filename: "c2.txt"))
    card2.comments.create!(creator: @user, body: embed_html(create_blob(size: 600, filename: "cm3.txt")))
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    assert_equal 1_200, @account.reload.bytes_used

    assert_enqueued_jobs 1, only: Storage::CleanupJob do
      @board.destroy!
    end
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(board_id: @board.id).count
  end

  test "board destruction preserves storage for cards concurrently moved to another board" do
    card_blob = create_blob(size: 500, filename: "moved.txt")
    staying_blob = create_blob(size: 300, filename: "staying.txt")

    card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Moved", creator: @user, status: :published, image: card_blob)
    @board.cards.create!(title: "Staying", creator: @user, status: :published, image: staying_blob)
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 800, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 800, @account.reload.bytes_used

    card.move_to(@other_board)
    @board.destroy!
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 500, @other_board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 500, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "creating and destroying before jobs run leaves zero usage" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 777, filename: "ephemeral.txt")
    card = @board.cards.create!(title: "Ephemeral", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    card.destroy!

    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 0, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 0, @account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "sync is idempotent and isolates accounts" do
    other_account = Account.create_with_owner(
      account: { name: "Other Account" },
      owner: { identity: identities(:mike), name: "Mike" }
    )
    other_owner = other_account.users.find_by!(role: :owner)
    other_board = Board.create!(name: "Other Board", creator: other_owner, account: other_account)

    blob1 = create_blob(size: 333, filename: "37s.txt")
    card = @board.cards.create!(title: "37s card", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob1)
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    card.sync_storage_now
    card.sync_storage_now

    Current.set(account: other_account, user: other_owner) do
      blob2 = create_blob(size: 444, filename: "other.txt")
      other_board.cards.create!(title: "Other card", creator: other_owner, status: :published, image: blob2)
    end
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    assert_equal 333, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 333, @account.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 444, other_board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 444, other_account.reload.bytes_used
  end

  test "reconcile_storage_now repairs drifted totals and orphaned entries" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 1_000, filename: "reconcile.txt")
    @board.cards.create!(title: "Tracked", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    perform_enqueued_jobs

    @board.update_column(:bytes_used, 999_999)
    @account.update_column(:bytes_used, 123)
    Storage::Entry.create!(
      account_id: @account.id,
      board_id: @board.id,
      card_id: "nonexistent_card_id",
      record_type: "Card",
      record_id: "nonexistent_card_id",
      bytes_used: 5_000
    )

    @account.reconcile_storage_now

    assert_equal 1_000, @board.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1_000, @account.reload.bytes_used
    assert_equal 1, Storage::Entry.where(account: @account).count
  end

  test "account destruction removes storage entries without errors" do
    blob = create_blob(size: 555, filename: "acct_destroy.txt")
    @board.cards.create!(title: "Card", creator: @user, status: :published, image: blob)
    perform_enqueued_jobs
    assert_equal 1, Storage::Entry.where(account: @account).count

    assert_no_enqueued_jobs only: Storage::CleanupJob do
      @account.destroy!
    end

    assert_equal 0, Storage::Entry.where(account_id: @account.id).count
  end

  private
    def create_blob(size:, filename:)
      ActiveStorage::Blob.create_and_upload!(
        io: StringIO.new("x" * size),
        filename: filename,
        content_type: "text/plain"
      )
    end

    def embed_html(*blobs)
      blobs.map { |blob| %(<action-text-attachment sgid="#{blob.attachable_sgid}"></action-text-attachment>) }.join
    end
end

This means multi-threading *within* a test will result in SQLite connection contention. So, while we can't fully replicate a truly isolated multi-threaded environment directly in these tests, we can still test critical scenarios.

Here's the plan:

*   I'll enqueue multiple jobs that work in parallel and see if we can generate a conflict or failure. Let's try mixing `sync`, `update`, `move_to`, and `cleanup` calls in a random, interleaved order.
*   I also need to check how `embeds.purge_later` and `embeds.detach` handle concurrency on `RichText` fields. Specifically, `board.public_description`, `card.description`, and `comment.body` are targets.
*   Let's throw in a direct destruction of `ActionText::RichText` objects too (e.g., `card.rich_text_description.destroy!`) to verify behavior.
*   Finally, let's incorporate integration tests that exercise our controllers. I need to cover `CardsController#update`, `Cards::ImagesController#destroy`, `Cards::BoardsController#update`, `Cards::CommentsController#create`/`update`/`destroy`, and `BoardsController#update`/`destroy`.
